title: buildstock-corpus release index
description: Every document and every measure of one dataset release of the corpus, for a consumer that reads the corpus over HTTPS without a clone. Generated by `bsc map`; stamps the manifest it describes.

corpus_version.description: The build this index describes: a release tag (<release id>-v<N>) or, before the first tag, a commit hash.

sections_file.description: Sibling file holding every document's headings and line ranges.

source_path.description: Upstream path or fetched-file path; the citation anchor.

source_url.description: The upstream file at the commit the corpus was built from, or the OSTI URL.

publication_url.description: Where a reader is sent for the human-readable form.

bytes.description: Size of the processed markdown file.

sections.description: Number of headings; the headings themselves are in sections.json.

chunks.description: Number of retrieval chunks cut from this document.

chunks_file.description: This document's rows of chunks.jsonl as their own JSON Lines file, byte for byte; relative to processed/<product>/<release>/.

upgrade_id.description: The measure's id within this dataset release; null when it is not in the release.

corpus_path.description: The document that covers this measure, or null for a gap.
